data.name: Rosanna
data.gender_notes: Rosanna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'rosa', meaning rose. The name Rosanna is of Greek origin and is a feminine name that translates to 'rose, lovely, or grace'. The name Rosanna carries the meaning “Rose, lovely, grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rosanna usually hope their child will grow to embody rose, lovely, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Rosanna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rose, lovely, grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rosanna total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
data.cultural_impact: The name Rosanna gained popularity in the English-speaking world due to the influence of Italian and Hispanic cultures. In Italy and Spain, the name Rosanna is commonly used and is associated with the beautiful and graceful qualities symbolized by the rose.
data.spiritual_significance: Rosanna is a name rich in symbolism and spiritual significance. In Christian traditions, roses are often used as symbols of the Passion of Christ, as they bloom in the Easter season. The name Rosanna can be seen as a reflection of the spiritual qualities of love, grace, and beauty, reminding us of the divine love and grace bestowed upon us by God. The name also signifies the spiritual journey towards inner beauty, growth, and transformation, as the rose blooms from a bud into a beautiful flower.
